basics.name: César Augusto Sobrino Pech
basics.label: Full Stack Developer with more than 5 years of experience.
basics.summary: With over 5 years of experience, I am a developer seeking both professional and personal growth. With stronger expertise in Frontend development, I enjoy bringing ideas and passion to the projects I’m involved in. I currently work for Billboardplanet, a multinational Outdoor Advertising company headquartered in the United States and Nepal.

work.name: Billboard Planet

work.summary: Full Stack development using Angular, SQL Server, and .NET Core as my main stack. Depending on the company's microservices, I also work with new technologies when needed.
